I fixed one layout problem on the about page, but I couldn't find a definite "last change" that broke it. The repo has a single commit, so there was nothing to diff against.

I changed the `.story` grid to two equal flexible columns (`repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))`). At 740px the text and image now share the row sensibly. I also rendered 1280px after the change, but I only looked at the 740px screenshot. The functional tests weren't run.

If you saw something different, such as a specific section or screen size, tell me and I'll look there. The earlier screenshots showed nothing else off.
